# Arjun Basnet

> Project Manager and AI Automation Engineer based in Kathmandu, Nepal. Three years at Makura Creations leading 100+ digital products across EdTech, digital transformation, and AI automation. Peer-reviewed publication in computer vision. Two-time recipient of the ICC Digital Fan Engagement Award for Cricket Nepal's digital transformation.

- [About](https://www.arjun-basnet.com.np/about): Professional story, education and work timeline, technical skills, certifications, and leadership
- [Work](https://www.arjun-basnet.com.np/work): Five case studies — Cricket Nepal digital transformation, K-12 and PSC/TSC LMS platforms, AI automation workflows using n8n and Claude, USEF Nepal, UWS Nepal
- [Research](https://www.arjun-basnet.com.np/research): Peer-reviewed publication on facial-detection attendance systems, open research questions in EdTech, AI, and information-system adoption
- [Contact](https://www.arjun-basnet.com.np/contact): Contact form, profile links, response time

## Core expertise

- Project management: Agile, Scrum, Kanban, JIRA, ClickUp, Confluence
- AI and automation: Claude API, n8n, LLM workflow orchestration, prompt engineering, Playwright MCP
- Educational technology: Learning Management Systems, K-12 platforms, exam preparation systems (PSC, TSC)
- Digital transformation: Web platforms, mobile applications, social media, fan engagement
- Engineering: Python, PHP, JavaScript, SQL, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Next.js, React, Laravel
- Research: Computer vision, IS adoption, adaptive learning analytics

## Notable engagements

- Cricket Nepal — digital transformation that won two consecutive ICC Digital Fan Engagement Awards (2023, 2024)
- Five LMS platforms deployed across Nepal serving K-12, Public Service Commission (PSC), and Teacher Service Commission (TSC) candidates
- Seven AI automation workflows that reduced SEO auditing and quotation generation cycle time from approximately 10 hours to 2 hours
- USEF Nepal (Fulbright and EducationUSA affiliate)
- UWS Nepal (University of Western Sydney Nepal)

## Publication

- Jha, P. B., Basnet, A., Pokhrel, B., Pokhrel, B., Thakur, G. K., & Chhetri, S. (2023). An Automated Attendance System Using Facial Detection and Recognition Technology. Apex Journal of Business and Management, Vol. 1, No. 1, pp. 103–120.
